consistent:
run Negative1 {
    some disj Track1, Track2 : Track | some disj Signal1 : Signal {
        Track = Track1 + Track2
        Signal = Signal1
        Speed = Signal1
        Semaphore = none
        Entry = Track1
        Exit = Track2
        Junction = none
        succs = Track1->Track2
        signals = Track2->Signal1

        some Entry
        some Exit
        all s: Signal | one t: Track | s in t.signals
        all t: Track | (t in Exit iff no t.succs)
        all t: Track | (t in Entry iff no t.~succs)
        all t: Track | (t in Junction iff #(t.~succs) > 1)
        all e: Entry | some (e.signals & Speed)
    }
} for 2 Track, 1 Signal expect 0

        all t: Track | (t in Exit iff no t.succs)
        all t: Track | (t in Entry iff no t.~succs)
